Bonus des titres que TMDb recommande à p: Bonus for titles TMDb recommends from several liked titles — outside the library (extended mode) as well as in the library (General tab, Sources) — only if they already fit the tastes (safeguard).

Bonus for titles watched by many accounts on the server, only if they already match the tastes (safeguard).

Bruit ajouté chaque jour au classement d: Noise added each day to the ranking of titles outside the library: 0 = always the same order, 0.3 = titles of similar value swap places, 1 = lots of movement. A clearly worse title never overtakes a very good one. Fixed for the day.
Ce que Reco+ écrit dans le journal de Je: What Reco+ writes to the Jellyfin log, live (Information level and above, set by Jellyfin). Values that look like secrets (key, token, password) are masked. Refreshed every 2 seconds while the tab is open.

Ce qui est lu en plus de l'historique: What is read besides the history
Ce qui est montré, sans changer le calcu: What is shown, without changing how tastes are computed: these settings apply after ranking (they take part neither in evaluation nor in calibration). They apply to {ROW}, Suggestions and extended mode; “More like this” is only filtered by ignored accounts.

Ces deux méthodes refont tout leur appre: These two methods redo all their learning for each group: it's the longest part of calibration. 0 = automatic: the square root of twice the groups above, rounded (2 → 2, 5 → 3, 10 → 4), never more than them.
Chaque facteur s'active ou se coupe, et: Each factor can be switched on or off, and strengthened or weakened (×1 = evaluated value, ×0.25 to ×3). Hover over ? to see what it does.
Chaque interrupteur coupé rend la main à: Each switch turned off hands that part back to Jellyfin.
Chaque méthode donne un chemin qui s'élo: Each method gives a path moving away from the current settings, measured step by step with cross-validation. Cautious: the shortest step that does almost as well as the best one (within one standard error) — without clear evidence, it moves less. The best step sometimes gains a little more, but more often follows the randomness of the history.
Chaque méthode est refaite sans un group: Each method is redone without one group of accounts and measured on that group, for each group. More groups = less noisy measurement (each training sees more accounts) but longer computation. 0 = automatic: the square root of the number of accounts, rounded (as many groups as accounts per group: 4 accounts → 2, 9 → 3, 16 → 4, 25 → 5), between 2 and 10, never more than the number of accounts.
Compte les heures réellement regardées (: Counts the hours actually watched (length of each episode) rather than the number of episodes: 150 episodes of 15 min don't weigh as much as 150 of 45 min. Unknown length: 45 min per episode.
Comptes calculés en même temps, et cas é: Accounts computed at the same time, and cases evaluated at the same time during calibration. 0 = automatic: half of the cores, so Jellyfin keeps enough to serve playback. More = faster, but more CPU used during computation.

First computation longer, then cached.

The first N of the TMDb list, for movies and for series.

Les titres les plus populaires sur TMDb: The most popular titles on TMDb right now (like Seerr's “Popular Movies” and “Popular Series”): longer-lasting than trends. Requires Seerr.
Liste actuellement servie (après filtres: List currently served (after filters, daily randomness and minimums). After Save, click “Recompute now” (otherwise each account is recomputed at its next activity).
Lit la liste de suivi Seerr de chaque co: Reads the Seerr watchlist of each linked account (one request per account on full computation).

Lit, via Seerr, les recommandations TMDb: Reads, through Seerr, the TMDb recommendations of each account's most liked titles (cached, shared with extended mode) and derives the "TMDb agreement" of library titles from them (Engine tab): what TMDb links to what the account likes, learned from all its users. A title recommended everywhere weighs less.
Masquages et avis de Jellyfin Enhanced: Jellyfin Enhanced hidden titles and reviews
Mode étendu : apport de chaque source: Extended mode: contribution of each source
Modèle de choix appris : apprend d'un co: Learned choice model: learns the 10 score weights at once (conditional logit: “which title was chosen among all those that could be suggested”), regularized towards the current settings, strength chosen by cross-validation; few parameters, so reliable with little history; about one minute. Slider search: tunes more than 30 settings one by one (grid then golden section), content and signals included; needs much more history; up to an hour. Neural network (experimental): small non-linear correction (96 parameters) added to the score, pulled back to zero without evidence; needs a lot of history; a few minutes. Automatic: all of them, keeping the one that generalizes best; long and CPU-hungry (up to an hour). Default: learned choice model.
Modèle de choix et réseau : à l'intérieu: Choice model and network: within each group, the regularization strength is chosen by a nested cross-validation over this many groups. 0 = automatic: 2.
Montré sans être ouvert : jours pour l'e: Shown without being opened: days for the effect
Mots-clés TMDb qui reviennent dans les t: TMDb keywords that recur in liked titles (“time travel”, “samurai”…): well-rated titles that carry them.
Moyenne bayésienne (méthode IMDb) : la n: Bayesian average (IMDb method): the community rating is pulled towards 6.5 as if this many 6.5 votes were added. A 9 rating from 12 votes becomes ≈ 6.7; from 20,000 votes it stays 9. Requires TMDb votes (Seerr). 0 = raw rating.
N'existe qu'après un calibrage « Réseau: Only exists after an applied “Neural network” calibration: small non-linear correction added to the score. Off: the engine ignores the correction (without deleting it). Without a learned correction, this setting has no effect.
Nombre d'avis fictifs à 3 étoiles mêlés: Number of virtual 3-star reviews mixed with the household reviews before averaging: with 2, a single 5-star review gives 3.7; five 5-star reviews give 4.4.
Nombre de premiers titres auxquels s'app: Number of first titles to which randomness and minimums apply. Keep it equal to “Titles per row” (General tab, 20 by default) so that they apply exactly to what {ROW} shows.
Nombre de titres aimés les plus récents: Number of most recent liked titles (latest activity) that form the current taste.
Nombre de tours sur tous les réglages (l: Number of rounds over all settings (the search stops earlier if a round changes nothing). 0 = automatic: 2.
Nombre maximal de titres hors bibliothèq: Maximum number of titles outside the library per account, across all rows: each one only goes into one row. By default all rows receive some: 40 leaves about 8 per row.
Nombre maximal de titres placés en tête: Maximum number of titles placed first: new episodes of a series watched on this server and caught up on, or liked and recently aired; the next part of a saga whose earlier parts were watched. 0 = never.
Note de la communauté : celle que fourni: Community rating: the one provided by the metadata (TMDb by default, IMDb with OMDb). Critics: otherwise, the community one. A title without a rating is neutral (6.5/10).
Note utilisée pour le bonus de qualité: Rating used for the quality bonus

Pages de recommandations et de titres si: Pages of TMDb recommendations and similar titles (about 20 titles each) read for each starting title (cached 3 days). 1 = closest only; TMDb sorts from closest to least close, the last pages drift away from the starting title.
Par genre, thème, studio ou langue : la: Per genre, theme, studio or language: the first page (top rated), then pages drawn at random each day. About 20 titles per page.
Par sorte (films, séries) : la première: Per kind (movies, series): the first page, then pages drawn at random each day.
Par sorte (films, séries) : les N couple: Per kind (movies, series): the N strongest genre × theme or genre × original language pairs in liked titles. Narrower lists: half the minimum votes is enough.
Part des goûts dans l'ordre: Share of taste in the order
Part du film (0-1) en dessous de laquell: Share of the movie (0-1) below which it is neither a taste nor an abandon.
Part du film regardée (0-1) à partir de: Share of the movie watched (0-1) from which it counts as watched.
Part du haut de liste (20 premiers titre: Share of the top of the list (first 20 titles by default) drawn at random among everything that can be suggested to the account (allowed libraries, not watched, filters respected), at positions also drawn at random. Personnalisée (par défaut, la mieux éval: Personalized (default, best evaluated): the list is as varied as what the account watches. Calibrated: each genre's share follows its share in the history. Fixed: the same redundancy penalty for everyone.
Personnalisée : plusieurs forces de dive: Personalized: several diversity strengths are tried and the list kept is the one whose variety most resembles that of what the account likes — an eclectic viewer gets a varied list, a fan of a single genre a focused one (best evaluated on the reference history). Calibrated (Steck, RecSys 2018): each genre's share in the list follows its share in the history (70% thrillers watched → about 70% suggested, not 100%). Fixed: the same redundancy penalty for everyone.
Places données aux titres hors bibliothè: Slots given to the best-rated titles outside the library (reliable TMDb rating: pulled towards the average while there are few votes, and at least as many votes as for hidden gems) that didn't find a place on their own, even slightly outside the account's habits. 0 = none.
Plus haut que pour les autres sources :: Higher than for the other sources: these are the recognized classics.
Plus haute que pour les autres sources :: Higher than for the other sources: with few votes, a rating is less reliable.

Poids de la décennie de sortie dans la r: Weight of the release decade in similarity.

Rejoue l'historique : chaque fois qu'un: Replays the history: each time an account started a new title, at what rank was that title in the recommendations computed just before, with only what was known at the time? Each case weighs according to the account's already known history, and accounts are balanced. Each method is redone without one group of accounts and measured on that group, for each group (cross-validation; by default, the square root of the number of accounts as groups), at each step of its path towards the learned settings; the most cautious step that does almost as well as the best one is kept. Settings are only recommended if their gain holds, reliably and by at least the minimum gain (1% by default), for accounts that weren't used to choose them (below that, nothing would be visible). Nothing is applied without your click; the Lists and General tabs are not involved. Also visible in Scheduled Tasks.

Un compte n'est jamais recalculé plus so: An account is never recomputed more often than this, even when very active. 0 = no limit. The “Recompute now” button ignores it.
Un film revu (2 lectures : moitié, 3 et: A movie rewatched (2 plays: half, 3 and more: full) or episodes rewatched (full at 3): sign of a beloved title. Never makes up for an abandon. Off by default: no gain measured on the reference history — Calibration may suggest it on yours.

Un titre ajouté à la liste de suivi Seer: A title added to the Seerr watchlist counts as a request, more weakly, and short term (same half-life, ignored after the same delay).
Un titre commencé n'est « abandonné » qu: A started title is only “abandoned” after this period without resuming: before that, it's simply in progress.
Un titre commencé puis laissé (après la: A title started then left (after the grace period) counts negatively. Stronger: an abandon says “not for me” more. Off: abandons are ignored.
Un titre demandé dans Seerr compte comme: A title requested in Seerr counts as a declared taste until it's watched (short-term signal, see the half-life). Stronger: what the account requests weighs more in its recommendations. Off: requests are ignored (arrived titles stay at the top, setting in the Lists tab).
Un titre filtré n'est jamais proposé. Un: A filtered title is never suggested. A title without a rating or year passes.
Un titre hors bibliothèque doit avoir au: A title outside the library must have at least this many TMDb votes, whatever the source (short films, previews, obscure titles ruled out). Unreleased titles are always ruled out.
Un titre masqué partout dans Jellyfin En: A title hidden everywhere in Jellyfin Enhanced is never suggested again, and what resembles it goes down. Hiding limited to a home row or episodes doesn't count.
Un titre mis en favori compte davantage: A favorite title counts more as a taste. Off: a favorite counts like a title simply watched.
Un titre pas encore sorti n'est presque: A title not yet released is almost never in the library: outside the library only by default.
Un titre resté plusieurs jours à l'écran: A title that stayed on the account's screen for several days without being opened is a discreet “no”: it loses part of its score (at most 40% at ×1, reached gradually), and gets it back over time. The account therefore sees something else instead of the same ignored cards. Opening it resets the counter. Requires “Titles shown without being opened” (General tab). Not measurable by calibration (no display history).
Un titre très ancien ne descend jamais s: A very old title never goes below this share of its weight (0-1).
Une collection plus grande que ce nombre: A collection larger than this number is not a saga but a grouping (“Marvel movies”, “Ghibli”): 2 entries at most, without the first-part rule.
Une demande jamais regardée ne compte pl: A request never watched no longer counts at all after this delay.
Une demande perd la moitié de son poids: A request loses half its weight after this delay.
Une langue d'origine n'est explorée que: An original language is only explored if it weighs at least this share of liked titles (e.g. Japanese for lots of anime).
Une saison mise en favori (sans la série: A favorite season (without the series) counts as this share of a favorite: you can like a season without liking the whole series.
Une seule entrée par saga, et c'est le p: Only one entry per saga, and it's the first part not yet watched (not the 4th when you haven't seen the 1st).
Utilisé seulement sans Jellyfin Enhanced: Only used without Jellyfin Enhanced. The request is made on behalf of the user, with their Seerr permissions and quotas.
Valeurs par défaut = réglage retenu aprè: Default values = settings kept after evaluation. The safeguard (freshness, popularity and rating bonuses reserved for titles that already match the account's tastes) is always active; freshness is capped at 4.
